module.name: Live Observability Cluster Adopt
module.description: Cloud-agnostic adoption step for the bnk-live-observability-foundation blueprint. Accepts a plain-text kubeconfig (from any Kubernetes cluster) and validates connectivity before downstream modules deploy Loki and Fluent Bit. Pass-through: wires forge_kubeconfig_content to all downstream modules via blueprint-level input. Does not auto-register the cluster in the Forge DB — see README for manual registration instructions.

required.name: cluster_name
required.description: Human-readable name for the target cluster. Used as a label in module outputs and Forge project context. Register this same cluster in Forge Clusters to enable PR #393 dashboard queries.

required.name: kubeconfig_content
required.description: Full plain-text kubeconfig for the target cluster. Sensitive — stored as a Forge project secret. Passed to downstream modules as forge_kubeconfig_content. Supports any Kubernetes cluster (EKS, AKS, GKE, ROKS, on-prem).

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: The cluster name provided as input. Passed through for downstream documentation and labelling.

key_outputs.name: cluster_api_server
key_outputs.description: Kubernetes API server URL extracted from the kubeconfig. Useful for diagnostics and Forge cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: adopt_ready
key_outputs.description: Gate output — true once kubectl can reach the cluster API server. Downstream namespace/loki/collector modules depend on this.
